"""Independently audit every byte, reference field, and local branch of Sweep."""
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
from dataclasses import asdict, replace
from pathlib import Path
import capstone
from snail import match as m

ROOT = Path('/Users/banteg/dev/banteg/snail-mail')
D = Path('/private/tmp/snail-bank-next-20260913')
NAME = 'initialize_sweep_path_template_pair'
config = m.load_scratch_config(ROOT/'tools/match/scratches'/NAME)
manifest = m.load_function_symbol_manifest(m.DEFAULT_FUNCTION_SYMBOL_MANIFEST_PATH)
image_path = ROOT/manifest.primary_target
start, end = m.resolve_function_extent(manifest, config.function, config.end_va)
target = m.load_image(image_path, manifest.image_base).function_bytes(start, end)


def audit(source):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='snail-sweep-audit-', dir='/private/tmp') as tmp:
        directory = Path(tmp)
        (directory/'scratch.cpp').write_text(source)
        obj = m.compile_scratch(replace(config, directory=directory))
        candidate = m.extract_object_function(m.parse_coff_object(obj.read_bytes()), config.symbol or config.function, reference_manifest=m.load_default_reference_symbol_manifest())
        result = m.run_match(obj_path=obj, function_name=config.function, image_path=image_path, manifest=manifest, symbol_name=config.symbol, end_va=config.end_va)
        tl, cl = result.target_disassembly, result.candidate_disassembly
        assert len(tl) == len(cl) == 652
        if result.body_byte_exact:
            assert all(t.offset == c.offset and t.size == c.size and t.text == c.text for t, c in zip(tl, cl))
        target_end = tl[-1].offset + tl[-1].size
        candidate_end = cl[-1].offset + cl[-1].size
        assert target_end == candidate_end == 2428
        a, b = bytearray(target[:target_end]), bytearray(candidate.data[:candidate_end])
        decoder = capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_X86, capstone.CS_MODE_32)
        decoder.detail = True
        references, consumed = [], set()
        for entry in result.masked_operand_audit.entries:
            assert entry.status == 'ok'
            assert entry.target_index == entry.candidate_index
            assert entry.target_offset == entry.candidate_offset
            assert len(entry.target_references) == len(entry.candidate_references)
            t, c = tl[entry.target_index], cl[entry.candidate_index]
            ti = next(decoder.disasm(target[t.offset:t.offset+t.size], t.offset))
            ci = next(decoder.disasm(candidate.data[c.offset:c.offset+c.size], c.offset))
            for x, y in zip(entry.target_references, entry.candidate_references):
                assert x.kind == y.kind and x.operand_index == y.operand_index
                assert x.explained and y.explained and y.source == 'reloc'
                assert m._reference_status((x,), (y,), strict=True) == 'ok'
                field = 'imm' if x.kind == 'imm' else 'disp'
                off, size = getattr(ti, field+'_offset'), getattr(ti, field+'_size')
                assert size == 4 and off == getattr(ci, field+'_offset') and size == getattr(ci, field+'_size')
                absolute = c.offset + off
                assert absolute in candidate.relocation_offsets and absolute not in consumed
                consumed.add(absolute)
                a[absolute:absolute+size] = bytes(size)
                b[absolute:absolute+size] = bytes(size)
                references.append({'instruction': entry.target_index, 'offset': absolute, 'size': size, 'kind': x.kind, 'operand_index': x.operand_index, 'identity': x.key})
        assert consumed == {off for off in candidate.relocation_offsets if off < candidate_end}
        assert len(references) == 37
        boundaries = {i.offset for i in tl}
        branches = []
        for index, (t, c) in enumerate(zip(tl, cl)):
            td, cd = m._local_branch_offsets(t), m._local_branch_offsets(c)
            assert td == cd
            if td:
                assert all(destination in boundaries for destination in td)
                assert target[t.offset:t.offset+t.size] == candidate.data[c.offset:c.offset+c.size]
                branches.append({'instruction': index, 'offset': t.offset, 'size': t.size, 'destinations': list(td), 'encoded_bytes': target[t.offset:t.offset+t.size].hex()})
        return {'source': source, 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(), 'raw_target': target.hex(), 'raw_candidate': candidate.data.hex(), 'audited_target_body': a.hex(), 'audited_candidate_body': b.hex(), 'audited_target_sha256': hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest(), 'audited_candidate_sha256': hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), 'different_byte_offsets': [i for i, (x,y) in enumerate(zip(a,b)) if x != y], 'native_extent': [start,end], 'compared_body': [0,target_end], 'strict_positional_references': references, 'local_branches': branches, 'diagnostics': m.match_result_payload(result), 'target_instructions': [asdict(i) for i in tl], 'candidate_instructions': [asdict(i) for i in cl], 'reference_audit': asdict(result.masked_operand_audit)}

proofs = {}
for label, path in [('baseline',D/'sweep-baseline.cpp'),('retained',D/'sweep-retained.cpp'),('mutable_borrow',D/'sweep/sample-bank-lifetimes/mutable-secondary-helper-arguments.cpp'),('const_signature_only',D/'sweep/independent-reversals/reverse-bank-use-7.cpp')]:
    proofs[label] = audit(path.read_text())
    print(label, proofs[label]['different_byte_offsets'], 'branches',len(proofs[label]['local_branches']), flush=True)
expected = [*range(378,394),418,425,436,895,995,1059]
assert proofs['baseline']['different_byte_offsets'] == expected
assert not proofs['retained']['different_byte_offsets']
assert proofs['retained']['diagnostics']['body_byte_exact']
assert proofs['mutable_borrow']['raw_candidate'] == proofs['retained']['raw_candidate']
assert proofs['const_signature_only']['raw_candidate'] == proofs['baseline']['raw_candidate']
before = bytes.fromhex(proofs['baseline']['raw_candidate'])
after = bytes.fromhex(proofs['retained']['raw_candidate'])
assert len(before) == len(after)
changes = [i for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(before,after)) if x != y]
assert changes == expected, changes
assert all(after[i] == target[i] != before[i] for i in changes)
assert all(not lo <= i < lo+4 for i in changes for lo in [r['offset'] for r in proofs['retained']['strict_positional_references']])
(D/'sweep-independent-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps({'controls': proofs, 'raw_candidate_changed_offsets': changes, 'audit_script': Path(__file__).read_text()},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Entire 2428-byte body verified; only 22 raw bytes changed, none relocation fields.')

from snail_next_probe import *
from dataclasses import replace,asdict
import capstone,tempfile


def encoded(name,text):
    config=m.load_scratch_config(ROOT/'tools/match/scratches'/name)
    manifest=m.load_function_symbol_manifest(m.DEFAULT_FUNCTION_SYMBOL_MANIFEST_PATH)
    image_path=ROOT/manifest.primary_target
    start,end=m.resolve_function_extent(manifest,config.function,config.end_va)
    target=m.load_image(image_path,manifest.image_base).function_bytes(start,end)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='snail-encoded-',dir='/private/tmp') as tmp:
        path=Path(tmp)
        (path/'scratch.cpp').write_text(text)
        shadow=replace(config,directory=path)
        obj=m.compile_scratch(shadow)
        candidate=m.extract_object_function(m.parse_coff_object(obj.read_bytes()),config.symbol or config.function,reference_manifest=m.load_default_reference_symbol_manifest())
        result=m.run_match(obj_path=obj,function_name=config.function,image_path=image_path,manifest=manifest,symbol_name=config.symbol,end_va=config.end_va)
        a=bytearray(target); b=bytearray(candidate.data)
        md=capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_X86,capstone.CS_MODE_32);md.detail=True
        audited=[]
        consumed=set()
        for entry in result.masked_operand_audit.entries:
            assert entry.status=='ok'
            assert entry.target_index==entry.candidate_index
            assert entry.target_offset==entry.candidate_offset
            left_refs=entry.target_references;right_refs=entry.candidate_references
            assert len(left_refs)==len(right_refs)
            for x,y in zip(left_refs,right_refs):
                assert x.kind==y.kind and x.operand_index==y.operand_index
                assert x.explained and y.explained
                assert m._reference_status((x,),(y,),strict=True)=='ok',(x,y)
                assert y.source=='reloc'
                ti=result.target_disassembly[entry.target_index];ci=result.candidate_disassembly[entry.candidate_index]
                left=next(md.disasm(bytes(a[ti.offset:ti.offset+ti.size]),ti.offset))
                right=next(md.disasm(bytes(b[ci.offset:ci.offset+ci.size]),ci.offset))
                field='imm' if x.kind=='imm' else 'disp'
                off=getattr(left,field+'_offset');size=getattr(left,field+'_size')
                assert size==4 and off==getattr(right,field+'_offset') and size==getattr(right,field+'_size')
                assert ci.offset+off in candidate.relocation_offsets
                consumed.add(ci.offset+off)
                a[ti.offset+off:ti.offset+off+size]=bytes(size)
                b[ci.offset+off:ci.offset+off+size]=bytes(size)
                audited.append({'instruction':entry.target_index,'offset':ti.offset+off,'size':size,'key':x.key})
        # Resolve local calls only after checking the destination identity.
        reloc={r.offset for r in candidate.relocation_references}
        for line in result.candidate_disassembly:
            local=m._local_branch_offsets(line)
            if not local:continue
            ins=next(md.disasm(candidate.data[line.offset:line.offset+line.size],line.offset))
            if line.offset+ins.imm_offset not in reloc:continue
            assert len(local)==1
            off=line.offset+ins.imm_offset;size=ins.imm_size
            consumed.add(off)
            value=(local[0]-line.offset-line.size)%(1<<(size*8))
            b[off:off+size]=value.to_bytes(size,'little')
        target_end=result.target_disassembly[-1].offset+result.target_disassembly[-1].size
        candidate_end=result.candidate_disassembly[-1].offset+result.candidate_disassembly[-1].size
        assert consumed=={off for off in candidate.relocation_offsets if off<candidate_end}
        diffs=[i for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a[:target_end],b[:candidate_end])) if x!=y]
        return {'target_bytes':bytes(a[:target_end]).hex(),'candidate_bytes':bytes(b[:candidate_end]).hex(),
                'raw_candidate':candidate.data.hex(),'raw_target':target.hex(),'target_length':target_end,'candidate_length':candidate_end,
                'different_byte_offsets':diffs,'positional_references':audited,'diagnostics':m.match_result_payload(result),
                'diff':result.diff_lines}


if __name__=='__main__':
    name='initialize_slalomdouble_path_template_pair'
    rows=[]
    for label in ['baseline','baseline-array-deltas','baseline-width-ref','returned-z-array-deltas']:
        s=(OUT/name/'phase-owners'/f'{label}.cpp').read_text()
        try:
            e=encoded(name,s)
            rows.append({'label':label,**e})
            print(label,len(e['different_byte_offsets']),e['different_byte_offsets'],flush=True)
        except AssertionError as e:print(label,'audit failed',str(e)[:200],flush=True)
    (OUT/name/'encoded-controls.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
